title: AI Workshop
description: Learn fundamentals of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning.
details: Join us for an interactive workshop covering neural networks, Python AI libraries, and practical machine learning applications. Date: March 20th, 2026 at Room 101.

title: Hackathon 2026
description: 48-hour coding marathon with prizes for top projects.
details: Build innovative software/hardware solutions in teams of 2 to 4. Free meals, mentor assistance, and over $5000 in prizes! Date: March 15th - 17th, 2026.

title: Placement Drive
description: Annual recruitment drive for graduating batches.
details: Meet recruiters from top MNCs and high-growth startups. Mandatory formal dress code and printed resumes required.

title: Poster Making
description: Creative poster design competition around Sustainability.
details: Express your creativity on the theme Environment & Tech Sustainability. Materials will be provided at the venue.

title: Talent Show
description: Showcase your singing, dancing, drama & music skills.
details: Auditions close April 10th. Open for individual and group performances. Winners earn trophies and certificates.

title: Coding Contest
details: Solve 5 algorithmic challenges in C++, Java, or Python. Test cases evaluated automatically on competitive coding platform.

title: AI Summit
description: Keynotes from leading researchers and tech leaders.
details: Full-day conference with keynote sessions, paper presentations, panel discussions on Generative AI and Ethics.

title: Startup Expo
description: Student startup pitches and investor networking.
details: Pitch your startup ideas to angel investors and seed funds. Winner receives $2000 seed grant funding.

title: Web Dev Bootcamp
description: Hands-on session on modern JavaScript & RESTful APIs.
details: Master asynchronous JavaScript, Fetch API, and component-based frontend web development from scratch.

title: Robotics Challenge
description: Obstacle course race and line-follower robot contest.
details: Design autonomous or RF-controlled robots to tackle obstacles. Cash prizes for the fastest completion times.

title: Photography Exhibition
description: Annual student photo showcase and competition.
details: Vote for the People's Choice Award across Portrait, Landscape, and Street Photography categories.

title: Resume & Mock Interview Workshop
description: 1-on-1 industry mentor feedback and HR practice sessions.
details: Bring printed copies of your resume for live review by alumni recruiters and take part in technical mock interviews.
